from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyReportMetrics(BaseModel):
    """Financial metrics extracted from a single company's financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company the report belongs to")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period covered by the financial data, e.g., Q1 2024")
    metric_label: str | None = Field(description="The label used in the document for the revenue change metric, e.g., '营业收入较上一报告期变化'")
    revenue_change_rate: float | None = Field(description="The percentage change in revenue compared to the previous period")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="The currency of the financial figures, e.g., CNY")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_reports: list[CompanyReportMetrics]
